string-array.name: level_limits
string-array.item: No restrictions. The opponent stands still so you can practice.
Planets cannot be upgraded.
Each planet holds at most 30 rocks, whatever its level.
Planets do not produce rocks. Your rocks are limited.
You have only 100 seconds to capture every planet.
Rocks can only fly a short distance (the dashed circle around each planet).
You cannot see the opponents\' rocks or HP.
Dense asteroids block the way: your rocks shatter when they hit one.
Each planet can send rocks only once every 4 seconds.
Every opponent produces rocks twice as fast as you.
Planets are very far apart and rocks fly very slowly. You can attack any planet, but every launch leaves you exposed.

string-array.name: level_tips
string-array.item: Follow the steps shown on screen.
With no upgrades, speed is everything: capture weak planets first for more production, then take on the strong ones.
Full planets waste rocks. Do not hoard: keep sending troops, or spend surplus rocks on upgrades.
Every rock counts. Attack the weakest planet first, avoid head-on fights and let the opponents wear each other down.
Loop rocks from several planets to strike one target together. Do not wait for a full army before attacking.
You cannot attack from afar. Capture the nearest planet as a stepping stone and keep going from there.
Send a small probe: the planet you hit reveals its rocks and HP for 3 seconds. Once you know, commit your forces.
Choose a clear flight path, send extra rocks to make up for the ones that shatter, or park rocks in open space until the asteroids drift past.
Loop rocks to launch from several planets at once, and time it so each launch is strong enough.
Strike early, before they build up. Planets you capture produce normally for you, so take down one opponent at a time.
Send just enough rocks to attack while keeping some for defense. A flashing red ring around a planet means it is exposed: do not send everything until you know who is watching you.

string-array.name: intro_steps
string-array.item: Press and hold your blue planet, drag to the red planet and let go. Half of your rocks fly out to attack.
Draw a loop around the rocks orbiting your planet to select them.
Tap the glowing circle in the middle of the screen: the selected rocks fly there and wait. Rocks from opposing sides shatter when they collide.
Tap your planet to upgrade it: it produces rocks faster, holds more and gains armor.
HP = rocks + armor. Keep sending rocks to the red planet until you capture it.
